newsitem.title: USA: Oakwood profits up, to add 15 to 20 stores by October.
newsitem.headline: Oakwood profits up, to add 15 to 20 stores by October.

text.p: Oakwood Homes Corp., reporting sharply higher third-quarter earnings, said Tuesday it expected to open 15 to 20 new stores by October.
Oakwood, based in Greensboro, N.C., manufactures homes and sells them through 275 stores and wholesale dealers in 27 states.

The company reported net earnings of $22.5 million or 48 cents a share for the quarter ended June 30, up from $17.9 million or 38 cents a share the year before. Retail sales rose 23.7 percent to a record $244.2 million from $197.4 million.
The earnings matched Wall Street expectations.
The company said it opened 12 new stores during the quarter and closed two underperforming outlets.
Oakwood's stock fell 25 cents to $24.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late composite trading.
